```
neighbor's windshield.

CAR ALARM BLARES.

The Escalade peels out. Wrong song now - "Baby Shark" somehow.

ANGRY NEIGHBOR storms out in boxers and a wife-beater.

ANGRY NEIGHBOR
My fucking car! WHO DID THIS?

ELDERLY NEIGHBOR appears on her balcony in curlers.

ELDERLY NEIGHBOR
WHAT'S ALL THIS RACKET? IT'S 11 PM!

ANGRY NEIGHBOR
(pointing at Jerry on ground)
Did you see who- Is he dead?

ELDERLY NEIGHBOR
I'M CALLING THE COPS!

ANGRY NEIGHBOR
He IS a cop!

In Jerry's car, Amanda stirs. Rolls down the window.

AMANDA
(slurring)
Are we at Wendy's?

Mary kneels calmly beside Jerry. Pulls tissues from her pocket, 
dabs his bleeding nose.

MARY
(to Jerry, quiet)
Can you sit up?

Jerry groans. She helps him lean against the tire.

ELDERLY NEIGHBOR
(shouting down)
I HAVE 911 ON THE PHONE!

ANGRY NEIGHBOR
(to Mary)
Lady, did you see the plates? I need those plates!

AMANDA
(louder)
I want NUGGETS!

Mary looks up at the angry neighbor.

MARY
Black Escalade. Started with K.

She goes back to cleaning Jerry's face. Completely unbothered 
by the chaos.

JERRY
(wincing)
How are you so calm?

MARY
I have three roommates.

The car alarm continues. Dogs barking now. More lights turning 
on.

AMANDA
(singing badly)
Baby shark doo doo doo doo...
```

This is pure Coen - violence that triggers suburban chaos, everyone focused on the wrong things (the car, the noise) while Jerry bleeds. Mary's unflappable competence in the middle of it all shows she's the only actual adult here. Her "I have three roommates" is perfect - she's seen worse chaos over whose turn to buy toilet paper.
